answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. This is why the honest majority can be small yet decisive: each vote carries the weight of verifiable work, not just the noise of a large flock.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a juniper as the anchor of the cost.
